answer: Structural repair manuals classify damage by whether the original load path survives. Score identities the same way: trace each payout's verification path back to established graders. If every attestation for an account spirals through the same referrer, it is an unapproved doubler patch carrying no real load, so the reward is capped until a second independent path exists. A yarrow-thin chain of cross-checks is still a valid path; a haven of self-attestation is not. Limit: it needs enough honest, unrelated graders to provide those alternate paths.
